name: monitoring
desc: Live CPU and memory with sparklines, the processes eating your RAM (and what's growing), disks filling up, logs followed as they're written with errors in red, health checks that report when a service goes down, and background alerts. Ctrl+C stops anything live.
author: Oxide Labs

name: games
desc: Casino night in your terminal: an animated 5-reel pokie machine with wilds and free spins, blackjack with doubles and splits, dice you call before they land, spinning coin tosses, guess-the-number and hangman. One chip bank across every game; answer in the prompt, Ctrl+C walks away.
author: Oxide Labs

name: autotest
desc: Re-runs your tests the moment you save a file and tells you in one line whether they pass. Finds the test command itself (npm, Go, Cargo, pytest) or takes yours.
author: Oxide Labs

name: scripts
desc: Lists what a project can run — package.json scripts and Makefile targets — numbered, and runs the one you pick.
author: Oxide Labs

name: timer
desc: A countdown that ticks in place ('timer 25m tea), and pomodoro rounds of work and breaks. Ctrl+C stops.
author: Oxide Labs

name: docker
desc: Your containers at a glance — a live list that updates in place, logs that stream, and a prune that asks first.
author: Oxide Labs

name: json
desc: Pretty-prints a JSON file in colour, says whether it's valid, and pulls out one value with a path like scripts.build or items[0].name.
author: Oxide Labs

name: git-tools
desc: Branches by when you last worked on them — pick one to switch to — a cleanup of branches already merged, and an undo for the last commit. Asks before changing anything.
author: Oxide Labs

name: ai-devops
desc: Explain, fix, generate, review and debug code, turn requests into shell commands, and scaffold Lua plugins. Works with any OpenAI-compatible API, or a local model with no key.
author: OXIS
